title: System Multiplexer Resume Command
description: Reconstitute one multiplexer session: for every agent pane the crash left held, drop the held command, start the pane's agent again with its continue/resume flag and tell it to continue where it left off. Sent by zellij-sentinel after bloodbank.system.multiplexer.failed once the session is back (trigger=failure: causationid = the failed event id, correlationid = the failed event's), at watchdog start (trigger=boot), or by hand (trigger=manual). Consumed by zellij-sentinel, which runs infra/scripts/zellij-reconstitute and answers with bloodbank.system.multiplexer.resumed. Single-consumer delivery; idempotency_key is derived by bin/bb-emit from the correlationid, so every resume of one incident shares one key. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (system, multiplexer).

causationid.description: trigger=failure: the bloodbank.system.multiplexer.failed event id that caused this resume.

failure_event_id.description: trigger=failure: the failed event id (the same value as causationid).

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket multiplexer:<multiplexer>:<session>, shared with the failed event and the resumed outcome. bin/bb-emit derives it from data.multiplexer and data.session.

multiplexer.description: The multiplexer that hosts the session.

trigger.description: failure: after a multiplexer.failed event (causationid and failure_event_id required). boot: the watchdog started and found the session's server absent. manual: an operator or agent asked.

failure_event_id.description: The bloodbank.system.multiplexer.failed event id this resume answers; null when none.

prompt.description: The continue prompt typed into every relaunched agent; null uses zellij-reconstitute's default.

dry_run.description: Resolve every pane's agent and launch line without touching a pane.
